sourceText: 先分析 review 和 dev 为什么反复；保障在进入 dev 前审查足够且无遗漏，多轮 review 直到不再发现新 finding；然后开始并完成第一个优化 Story。
normalizedOutcome: Freeze one REVIEW candidate, complete all required review lanes and a completeness critic until a zero-new-verified-finding saturation wave, then enter one aggregated remediation DEV and run fresh final review without reducing quality assurance.
acceptanceClaim: The B-cdf6 replay reduces mutation-driven reviewer redispatches from at least five to zero while accepted OPEN commits, stale acceptance, escaped critical/high findings, post-cert commits and assurance regressions remain zero.
